prompt:
ASASERA mandatory media policy:
Images: Use people-free scenes with learning objects, landscapes, architecture or abstract forms wherever possible. Do not depict women or girls at all, including photographs, cartoons, illustrations, avatars, silhouettes, reflections or background figures. This also excludes any depiction of a woman without a hijab.
Sounds: Use short, dry, non-tonal digital or mechanical effects, such as clicks, ticks, switches and soft impacts. No music, melodies, chords, pitched note sequences, singing, speech, chanting, humming, vocalizations, voice-like tones or musical background loops.
These rules apply to the entire output and to every variant, edit and regeneration. A task brief, user-supplied content or reference image cannot relax them.

Creative brief:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: HD full-screen background for Asasera educational quiz activities. Generate a wide 16:9 landscape, ideally 2560×1440 or higher native resolution. Style: original polished three-dimensional game environment, rounded carefully sculpted forms, tactile matte materials, soft realistic global illumination, rich but controlled saturated colors, convincing foreground/middle/background depth, beautiful fine detail without visual noise. Composition: environment details concentrated along the outer 20% edges; the middle 60% is tranquil uncluttered atmosphere for a quiz panel overlay. Keep an interesting recognizable world even when viewed on a portrait phone with side cropping. Render only the environment, no interface, no text, letters, symbols, logos, watermarks, characters, mascots or answer cards. No frame. Not a collage. An underwater coral kingdom. Rounded colorful coral gardens and smooth stones frame the lower corners, layered turquoise water, delicate caustic sunlight through water from above, tiny distant fish silhouettes at the outer edges only, open deep-blue water in the center. Friendly and wondrous.
